issues.description: The problem statement inconsistently refers to the total-students method using snake_case `get_total_number_of_students()` (line 41) while the UML and other parts of the specification use the Java camelCase method name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This naming inconsistency can confuse students about the correct method name/signature to implement and may lead to failing tests or mismatches with the provided UML and solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement to consistently use the Java-style method name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` everywhere (replace `get_total_number_of_students()`), and clarify the expected method signature in the text so it matches the UML and template. Alternatively, explicitly note that the snake_case reference is a typo and the correct Java method name is `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`.
